_comment: FreshIQ device configuration. Everything the rig needs to know about ITSELF lives here. Model/threshold tuning lives in ai/config.py. Copy this file, edit, and restart the server - nothing here requires a code change.
_mode: production = real camera + real motor. development = simulated motor and sample images, so the whole scan can be exercised on a laptop with no hardware.

tray._compartments: 4 is what the CAD tray actually has (cad/freshiq_cad/params.py BUILD.n_compartments). Change BOTH if you reprint a different tray.
tray._steps_per_revolution: NEMA 17 at 1.8 deg/step. Drive is 1:1 direct through the coupling hub - no gearing - so one tray revolution is one motor revolution.
tray._microsteps: A4988 MS1/MS2/MS3 setting: 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16. VERIFY against your DIP switches / jumpers. steps_per_compartment = steps_per_revolution * microsteps / compartments.
tray._stabilize_seconds: Dead time after the motor reports STOPPED before the camera is allowed to capture. The tray is a 200 mm platter on a lazy-susan bearing; it keeps wobbling after the motor stops. Raise this if images look motion-blurred.
tray._seconds_per_compartment: How long ONE compartment of travel should take. The MCU is told a per-step delay derived from this and steps_per_compartment, so changing the speed is a config edit and a restart - no re-flash. Raise it for a gentler tray, lower it for a faster scan. Must stay below motor.ack_timeout_seconds.

motor._driver: bridge = the Arduino UNO Q's ONBOARD MCU, reached through the arduino-router RPC service. This is correct for this board: the MCU is on the same PCB and never appears as /dev/ttyACM*. serial = a SEPARATE Arduino wired over USB. simulated = no hardware, movement is faked with sleeps. auto = bridge if the router socket exists, else serial.
motor._rpc_socket: Where arduino-router listens. Only used by driver 'bridge'. Check the service with: systemctl status arduino-router
motor._port: Only used by driver 'serial'. auto = find an external Arduino, preferring /dev/ttyACM* over /dev/ttyUSB*. Ignored entirely by driver 'bridge'.
motor._ack_timeout_seconds: How long to wait for the MCU to report the move finished. Must exceed the longest single-compartment move. One compartment at 50 full steps takes well under a second, so 15 s is generous.

camera._index: OpenCV camera index. On Linux /dev/video0 is usually index 0. Check with: ls /dev/video*
camera._views_per_compartment: Photos taken per compartment. The tray does NOT move between them - they are repeat shots of the same item, which the AI aggregates (worst view wins). Raise to 2-3 if single shots are noisy.

lighting._mode: always_on = white LED strip wired straight to 12 V, no software control. This is the configured hardware. The AI is colour-sensitive, so constant lighting is a feature, not a limitation - just never mix in daylight or RGB.

server._host: 0.0.0.0 so phones and laptops on the same Wi-Fi can reach it. Do NOT port-forward this to the internet; it has no authentication.

storage._retention: Oldest images are deleted once EITHER limit is exceeded. The JSONL history is never auto-deleted - it is tiny.
